title: Host's own ayahuasca experience

tellings.quote: I did I did Iaska once, so I've never done DMT

plain: Michels says he has taken ayahuasca, a plant brew known for producing strong visions, once, but has never taken DMT, a powerful psychedelic compound. He mentions it about himself while talking with the neuroscientist Andrew Gallimore, who studies DMT and the worlds people report seeing on it.
